whenToUse: Profile previews on a person's name or avatar, with photo, handle, role and join date
Feature, image and release note previews shown on hover or focus of a button or link
Exact dates and times behind a short inline label, such as a relative deploy time in a sentence

whenNotToUse.when: Content opened by a click or tap, such as a form or settings to change
A one line label that names an icon button or a control
Content that stays visible in the page layout without a pointer over it

agentNotes: Timing is `delay` and `closeDelay` on the base `HoverCardTrigger` but `openDelay` and `closeDelay` on the radix `HoverCard` root
Without `render` on the base twin or `asChild` on radix, `HoverCardTrigger` renders a link with no href, which Tab skips
The radix `HoverCardContent` sets tabindex -1 on every link and button inside it, so keep keyboard actions outside the card
